item.description: LANSING, Mich. item.title: MSU students reflect on 3rd anniversary of mass shooting
item.description: EAST LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) - Friday marks three years since the deadly mass shooting at Michigan State University. That night, gunman Anthony McRae opened fire inside Berkey Hall and the MSU Union, killing students Arielle Anderson, Brian Fraser, and Alexandria Verner and injuring five others before police say he took his own life. item.title: Ex-sheriff Wriggelsworth's 50-year journey in new book
item.description: Chivon Kloepfer interviews former Ingham County Sheriff Gene Wriggelsworth about his 50 years of law enforcement experience in Michigan, and his new book "50 Years of Duty" on her show "Catching Up! with Kloepfer" which airs Fridays at 8 a.m. on WLNS+.
